quest.title: Garden Fairies
quest.description: At Festival Utsava, Aralila and Aranishat seem to be fighting over something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'll beat Aranishat this time!

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Golden Nara is indeed impressive to see through it so quickly... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Golden Nara is impressive, but it's mainly because Aralila is too weak. Aranishat will not be found so quickly. Humph! Just watch.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Aranishat was also found quickly. As weak as Aralila!

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Wah... All weak. Only Golden Nara is strong...

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: This is bad! Must train Ararakalari. With very strong Ararakalari, Nara friend won't be able to find me!

choices.text: I don't think that's how this works...

response.speaker: Aralila
response.text: Are you afraid of losing? There's no need to care about winning or losing when playing games!

response.speaker: Aralila
response.text: Even though I lost, I had fun. Golden Nara is a good Nara after all.

response.speaker: Aranishat
response.text: Our Nara friend wins. Awesome! Please take our flowers!

response.speaker: Aralila
response.text: Thank you, good Nara! You are a good friend!

response.speaker: Aranishat
response.text: Yeah! I won't lose next time!

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Nara friend, come play with Aralila! Aranishat is very weak. Don't play with him.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Pfft, Aralila lost to Aranishat last time, so Aralila is weaker.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Fine, let's not bother about the sun and moon. Nara friend is here, so let's play with Nara friend. Let's compete to see who is stronger.

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Fine, let's compete. Aranishat's not scared.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Aralila hides first, then Nara friend comes to search. After that, Aranishat will hide, and Nara friend will search. The one who gets found first loses.

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Do you want to play, Nara Friend? Let's start right away if you're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Aralila
dialogues.text: Do you want to play, Nara Friend? Let's start right away if you're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Aranishat
dialogues.text: Good Nara, do not forget! I will have a decisive battle against Aralila!
